scenes.alt: भरे दरबार में राजा को एक साधारण फल देता तपस्वी
scenes.prompt: A morning court with tall pillars and slanting sunlight; a long line of petitioners; Kshantishil places one ordinary wild fruit in the seated king's palm. Vikram wears royal day robes.

scenes.alt: पुरानी कोठरी की ऊँची खिड़की से फल डालता ख़ज़ांची
scenes.prompt: A treasurer on tiptoe drops a fruit through a small high window of a long-locked storeroom at the back of the treasury; dust, an old lock, evening light.

scenes.alt: फटे फल से निकला रत्न, पास बैठा बंदर, स्तब्ध दरबार
scenes.prompt: In the court, a pet monkey beside the throne chews fruit while a brilliant red gem rolls on the marble floor; the king and courtiers frozen in astonishment.

scenes.alt: दीये की रोशनी में सड़े फलों के बीच चमकते रत्नों का ढेर
scenes.prompt: The opened storeroom: black rotted soil with white mould, scattered gems glittering where a trembling lamp reaches; the treasurer holds the lamp, the king stands in the doorway.

scenes.alt: राजा के कान में धीमे से अपनी माँग कहता क्षान्तिशील
scenes.prompt: Kshantishil leans close to speak softly to the king, the fruit back in his cloth bag; the hushed court watches.

scenes.alt: घटते चाँद के नीचे छत पर अकेले टहलते राजा
scenes.prompt: The king walks alone on a palace terrace at night beneath a thin waning moon, restless.

scenes.alt: आधी रात के श्मशान में तलवार की मूठ थामे अकेले राजा
scenes.prompt: The king enters a vast cremation ground: smouldering pyres throwing long shadows, jackals and an owl, ash underfoot; his hand tight on the sword hilt.

scenes.alt: बरगद के नीचे आग की रोशनी में घेरे बनाता क्षान्तिशील
scenes.prompt: Under an immense banyan with hanging roots, Kshantishil bends by a small fire drawing exact lines and circles on the ground without looking up; the king arrives.
